tasks.subject: Task 1: Shared freeVarsExpr in Wok.IR.Anf
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Promote the pass's free-var walk into Wok.IR.Anf so the Perceus pass and RC interpreter share one definition (anti-drift). Pure refactor.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Anf.hs", "src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Anf exports freeVarsExpr + helpers", "Perceus imports them; bndU renamed binderUnique", "all goldens byte-identical"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Interpreter NClosure free-var capture (RLam)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** evalRhsRC's RLam case captures Map.restrictKeys (rscEnv sc) (freeVarsExpr e minus params). Semantics-preserving; fixes whole-env over-capture double-free.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"RLam free-var capture\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RLam cell captures only free vars", "uncaptured local survives a call", "existing closure tests green (re-bless tightened goldens)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Pass instruments standalone RLam
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bring RLam into coverage; count free owned boxed captures as moves at build; instrument the lambda body as its own owned scope (params+captures, joins reset).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"closure instrumentation\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["coveredRhs admits RLam when body covered", "ownedOccs RLam = capture move multiset", "lambda body is its own owned scope", "hand-built closure heap-empty after insertRC"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: balanceLint models closure capture-as-consume
tasks.description:
**Goal:** moveAtoms RLam returns captures; lint descends into the lambda body as a fresh owned scope; remove the exprHasLam refusal guard.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"closure lint\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["moveAtoms RLam = captures", "lint descends into lambda body", "exprHasLam refusal removed", "balanced closure lints []; missing-drop reported"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Relax boundary guard + closure corpus (Phase 1 e2e)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Drop RLam from exprScopeFeatures (keep Handle/ROp; still scan lambda bodies); add 5 closure .wok programs so Suites A/B/C run end-to-end.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Reachable.hs", "test/rc-examples/26-closure-capture.wok", "test/rc-examples/27-closure-call-twice.wok", "test/rc-examples/28-closure-returned.wok", "test/rc-examples/29-closure-hof-arg.wok", "test/rc-examples/30-closure-unused.wok"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RLam no longer a boundary violation; Handle/ROp still are", "5 closure programs pass Suite A + Suite B", "Suite C mutations still fire"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Suite F closure-cluster generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add genClosureCluster (build/call/call-twice/return/drop over a seeded boxed capture), weighted into the genJoinCluster chooser; verify teeth.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"Suite F\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["genClosureCluster added + weighted", "Suite F passes over generated closures", "teeth: reverting capture-move fails fast"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Interpreter LetRec member free-var capture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Restrict each LetRec member's NClosure to Map.restrictKeys groupEnv (freeVarsExpr body minus params). Knot still ties. Prereq for Phase 2.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"LetRec free-var capture\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["member NClosure captures only free vars", "knot still ties", "uncaptured enclosing local survives group drop"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Pass instruments LetRec enclosing-capture (borrow)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Relax Set.null coverage guard; move enclosing captures into the region with multiset dups (need(y) = capturing-members + survives - 1); captures exempt (borrowed) in member bodies; region-to-region capture still rejected.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"letrec capture\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Set.null guard relaxed for non-region captures", "multiset dups at group build", "captures exempt in member bodies", "region-to-region capture still rejected", "hand-built group heap-empty"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: balanceLint mirrors LetRec borrow model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** checkExpr LetRec relinquishes group-build capture moves (multiset, balanced by inserted dups); audit member bodies with captures exempt (lintDefWithCaps).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"letrec capture lint\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["capture moves relinquished multiset-many times", "member bodies treat captures exempt", "Task 8 group lints []; mutant reported"]}
```
